document_edition: Manual Brasileiro de Sinalização de Trânsito, Volume I, 2ª edição, Brasília: CONTRAN, 2007; 222 PDF pages; copyright notice 2005

source_access_history.operation: Download apenas do PDF público autorizado, usando urllib padrão.
Public official alternative download; no retry of Seara source

render.tool: installed pypdfium2 PDFium renderer; PIL crop only
render.transformations: Same square crop size for both signs. Original raster resolution retained; no enhancement, repainting, synthesis or overlaid text. Labels, sign codes and explanatory text excluded.
render.crop_coordinate_space: Full source page rendered at scale 4 (2382 x 3368), not the archived scale-2 preview. Both neutral crops are 360 x 360; no candidate pixels changed.

visual_inspection.method: view_image of complete page and final neutral crop
visual_inspection.observation: Black letter E, circular red border and one red diagonal.

page_convention: facts.page identifies the source PDF page; bboxes refer to the 360x360 candidate crop, not the whole source page.

reuse.attribution: CONTRAN/DENATRAN, Manual Brasileiro de Sinalização de Trânsito, Volume I, 2ª ed., 2007, p. 141; Ministry of Transport official copy. Crop for this research exercise.
reuse.verified_notice: PDF copyright © 2005 CONTRAN; landing-page footer is not treated as an express licence for cropping the PDF.
reuse.publication_limit: No specific authorization for public redistribution of these crops was verified. Keep source attribution and check reuse before publishing this research package.

limits: Historical document exercise; no claim about current traffic law or a real event.
Both signs share the same PDF and family; they are a minimal contrast, not independent sources.
The letter is partly occluded by diagonals; region and interpretation remain assistant proposals awaiting human review.
Native source is rasterized at modest resolution; magnification creates no new detail.
No descriptive title, official sign code, reference answer or source URL is supplied to a candidate.
A remembered official sign is not independent proof of reading the provided pixels.
No actual offence, guilt, identity, intention, liability or causal relationship is inferred.
